# foreman_partitiontable (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_partitiontable" "centos_lvm" {
  name = "CentOS LVM"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the partitiontable to look up.

### Read-Only

- `audit_comment` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `layout` (String)
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether or not the template is locked for editing
